summary: Verified fix for create intent parsing in فوري tab. When user enters 'انشى عمليه بيع قطعه قلب شاص من قطع راكان على ماجذ العنزي', the bot correctly: (1) detects create intent via parseCreateIntent, (2) switches to إنشاء tab, (3) selects parts_sale template, (4) shows summary before execution with missing fields (المبلغ), (5) does NOT show report/statement phrases.
critical_code_review_comments: parseCreateIntent function correctly handles dialect variations (انشى/انشي/سجل/سوي)
Template detection for 'بيع قطع' works correctly when text contains 'بيع' + (قطع|قطعه|قطعة|غيار|part)
Summary display (🧾 ملخص قبل التنفيذ) shows type, description, partner, and missing fields
No LLM call is made for create commands - handled locally via parseCreateIntent
context_for_next_testing_agent: Create intent parsing fix verified. parseCreateIntent handles Arabic dialect variations and correctly identifies template type. Summary is shown before execution with missing fields highlighted.
